blurb.en: Turn the four arrow keys into a direction vector and multiply it by the speed. Straight moves come out at the right speed, but diagonal ones about 1.41 times too fast - and a race in the window shows it.
blurb.zh: 把四个方向键变成一个方向向量，再乘以速率。横着、竖着走速率正好，斜着走却快了约 1.41 倍——窗口里的一场赛跑就看得出来。

en: What the window shows: a dark background with the arc of a grey ring around the top-left corner. Two squares set off together from that corner - the blue one straight to the right, the pink one diagonally down and to the right. The pink one reaches the ring first and stops on it; the blue one arrives later. The white square near the bottom is yours: the arrow keys move it, and holding two keys at once moves it diagonally. Close the window to quit. Reading the keys and the QUIT event are covered on the Pygame Basics page; this program is about what to do with the keys once you have them.

velocity turns the four booleans into a direction: right minus left for x, down minus up for y (pygame's y axis points down the screen). int(True) is 1 and int(False) is 0, so each component is -1, 0 or 1, and holding both keys of a pair cancels out. Multiplying the direction by speed gives a velocity in pixels per second, which the function hands back as a plain tuple of two floats.

The flaw: a diagonal direction is (1, 1), whose length is the square root of 2, about 1.41, not 1. With a speed of 200 the straight racer moves at 200 pixels per second but the diagonal one at about 282.8. The ring is 300 pixels from the start, so the straight racer needs 1.5 seconds and the diagonal one only about 1.06. A game written like this lets players run faster by running diagonally; the fix is the Diagonal Speed, Normalised program.

Each racer is a small list [position, velocity, colour], with the position and velocity as Vector2s. A racer moves only while distance_to says it is still inside the ring, so it stops within one frame's step of reaching it.

The page's checker compares velocity with a version that never builds a Vector2 - it turns each key into 1 or 0 by hand and multiplies each component separately - on hundreds of made-up key combinations and speeds.
zh: 窗口里看到的：深色背景，左上角绕着一段灰色圆环的弧。两个方块从那个角同时出发——蓝的径直向右，粉的斜着往右下。粉的先到圆环、停在环上；蓝的晚一些才到。靠近底部的白方块归你：方向键移动它，同时按住两个键就斜着走。关掉窗口即退出。读按键、处理 QUIT 事件在「pygame 入门」一页讲；这个程序讲的是拿到按键之后怎么用。
velocity 把四个布尔变成一个方向：x 是右减左，y 是下减上（pygame 的 y 轴朝屏幕下方）。int(True) 是 1、int(False) 是 0，所以每个分量是 -1、0 或 1，一对键同时按住就互相抵消。方向乘以 speed 就是以「像素每秒」计的速度，函数把它当作两个浮点数组成的普通元组交回去。
毛病在这里：斜向的方向是 (1, 1)，长度是根号 2，约 1.41，不是 1。速率 200 时，直走的方块每秒走 200 像素，斜走的却约 282.8。圆环离起点 300 像素，所以直走要 1.5 秒，斜走只要约 1.06 秒。这样写的游戏，玩家斜着跑就比直着跑快；改法见「斜向速度：先归一化」。
每个赛跑者是一个小列表 [位置, 速度, 颜色]，位置与速度都是 Vector2。只有 distance_to 说它还在圆环以内时才走，所以到环之后最多再多走一帧的一步就停下。
页面的检查器把 velocity 与一个从不构造 Vector2 的版本比较——它手工把每个键变成 1 或 0、逐个分量相乘——在几百组随手造的按键组合与速率上逐一核对。

lineNotes.en: Multiplying a Vector2 by a number scales both components: (1, 1) * 200 is (200, 200).
lineNotes.zh: Vector2 乘一个数，两个分量都乘：(1, 1) * 200 就是 (200, 200)。

lineNotes.en: clock.tick(60) waits just long enough that the loop runs at most 60 times a second, and returns the milliseconds since its last call; dividing by 1000 turns them into seconds.
lineNotes.zh: clock.tick(60) 等到刚好让循环每秒最多跑 60 次，并交回距上一次调用过了多少毫秒；除以 1000 换成秒。

blurb.en: The same arrow-key mapping, but the direction is normalised to length 1 before it is scaled, so diagonal and straight moves have the same speed. A vector of length zero cannot be normalised, so 'no key held' needs its own check.
blurb.zh: 同样的方向键映射，只是先把方向归一化成长度 1 再乘速率，于是斜着走与直着走一样快。长度为零的向量没法归一化，所以「一个键都没按」要单独判断。

en: What the window shows: the same race as in the Diagonal Speed, Unnormalised program - a blue square going straight right and a pink one going diagonally, both from the top-left corner towards the grey ring. This time they reach the ring at the same moment, after 1.5 seconds. The white square at the bottom moves with the arrow keys at the same speed in all eight directions.

normalize() returns a new vector with the same direction and length 1: (1, 1) becomes about (0.707, 0.707). Multiplied by 200 that is about (141.42, 141.42), whose length is 200 again. A straight direction such as (1, 0) already has length 1, so normalising leaves it alone.

The catch is the zero vector. With no key held, or both keys of a pair, the direction is (0, 0): it has no direction to keep, and normalize() raises ValueError on it. So the function normalises only when length() is greater than 0; otherwise direction stays (0, 0) and the velocity comes out as (0.0, 0.0).
Compared with the Diagonal Speed, Unnormalised program only two lines are new; the race and the player square are unchanged, which is what makes the two windows easy to compare.

The page's checker compares velocity with a version that divides each component by the length from math.hypot and treats the zero direction separately, on hundreds of made-up key combinations and speeds.
zh: 窗口里看到的：与「斜向速度：不归一化」同一场赛跑——蓝方块径直向右、粉方块斜着走，都从左上角奔向灰色圆环。这一次两个同时到环，都用 1.5 秒。底部的白方块随方向键移动，八个方向一样快。
normalize() 交回一个方向相同、长度为 1 的新向量：(1, 1) 变成约 (0.707, 0.707)。乘以 200 约是 (141.42, 141.42)，长度又回到 200。像 (1, 0) 这样的直向本来长度就是 1，归一化不改变它。
麻烦在零向量。一个键都没按、或一对键同时按住时，方向是 (0, 0)：它没有方向可保留，normalize() 对它抛 ValueError。所以函数只在 length() 大于 0 时才归一化；否则 direction 保持 (0, 0)，速度交回 (0.0, 0.0)。
与「斜向速度：不归一化」相比只多了两行；赛跑与玩家方块都没变，两个窗口因此很好对照。
页面的检查器把 velocity 与另一个版本比较：它用 math.hypot 求长度、每个分量除以长度，零方向单独处理——在几百组随手造的按键组合与速率上逐一核对。

lineNotes.en: direction now has length 1 (or is the zero vector), so the velocity's length is exactly speed (or 0).
lineNotes.zh: 此时 direction 的长度是 1（或者是零向量），所以速度的长度正好是 speed（或 0）。

lineNotes.en: get_pressed() gives a sequence indexed by key constants, True while that key is held (see the Pygame Basics page).
lineNotes.zh: get_pressed() 交回一个按键常量作下标的序列，某个键按住时对应项为 True（见「pygame 入门」一页）。

blurb.en: A dot follows the mouse pointer at a fixed speed using Vector2.move_towards, which never overshoots: once the pointer is within one step, the dot lands exactly on it. When the pointer leaves the window there is no target, and the dot waits where it is.
blurb.zh: 一个圆点以固定速率追鼠标指针，用的是 Vector2.move_towards——它从不冲过头：指针进入一步之内，圆点就正好落在指针上。指针离开窗口就没有目标，圆点原地等着。

en: What the window shows: a green dot in the middle of a dark window. Move the mouse into the window and a grey ring appears around the pointer; the dot glides towards it in a straight line at 250 pixels per second. When it arrives it sits under the pointer without trembling. Move the pointer out of the window and the ring disappears and the dot stops where it is.

move_towards(target, max_distance) returns a new vector moved towards target by at most max_distance; if target is closer than that, it returns target itself. Here the most it may move is speed * dt - about 4.17 pixels a frame at 60 frames a second - so the speed is the same at any frame rate.

Why not add 'direction times step' by hand? That version jumps past the pointer whenever it is closer than one step, jumps back on the next frame, and so on - the dot shivers. It also has to normalise the direction, which fails when the dot is exactly on the pointer. move_towards deals with both.

None means 'no target'. Each frame target starts as None and gets a position only while pygame.mouse.get_focused() says the pointer is over the window; step_toward then leaves the position alone. Testing with 'is not None' is the usual way to ask whether a value was given.

The page's checker compares step_toward with a version that measures the distance with math.hypot and moves by that fraction of the gap, on hundreds of made-up positions, targets (some None, some equal to the position), speeds and frame times.
zh: 窗口里看到的：深色窗口中间一个绿色圆点。把鼠标移进窗口，指针周围出现一个灰色圆环；圆点沿直线以每秒 250 像素滑向它，到了就停在指针下面，不抖。把指针移出窗口，圆环消失，圆点停在原处。
move_towards(target, max_distance) 交回一个朝 target 移动了至多 max_distance 的新向量；target 比这更近时，交回的就是 target 本身。这里至多走 speed * dt——每秒 60 帧时一帧约 4.17 像素——所以不论帧率多少，速率都一样。
为什么不自己写「方向乘步长」再加上去？那样写，指针比一步还近时圆点会冲过头，下一帧又跳回来，如此反复——圆点发抖。它还得先归一化方向，而圆点正好在指针上时归一化会失败。move_towards 把这两件事都处理了。
None 表示「没有目标」。每一帧 target 先设为 None，只有 pygame.mouse.get_focused() 说指针在窗口里时才得到一个坐标；否则 step_toward 不改位置。用 is not None 判断，是问「给没给这个值」的惯用写法。
页面的检查器把 step_toward 与另一个版本比较：它用 math.hypot 量距离，按比例走过这段距离的一部分——在几百组随手造的位置、目标（有的是 None，有的与位置重合）、速率与帧时长上逐一核对。

lineNotes.en: Vector2 accepts a tuple; the caller's tuple is left unchanged.
lineNotes.zh: Vector2 可以直接收一个元组；调用者的元组不会被改动。

lineNotes.en: Each frame starts with no target; only a pointer over the window sets one.
lineNotes.zh: 每一帧都从「没有目标」开始；只有指针在窗口里才设上。

blurb.en: Arrow keys push a ship: the acceleration changes the velocity a little every frame, and the velocity moves the ship. clamp_magnitude caps the speed by the vector's length, so the ship is no faster diagonally.
blurb.zh: 方向键推一艘飞船：加速度每帧改一点速度，速度再移动飞船。clamp_magnitude 按向量的长度限速，所以斜着飞也不会更快。

en: What the window shows: an orange circle - the ship - in the middle, and 'speed 0' in the top-left corner. Hold an arrow key and the ship speeds up gradually; let go and it keeps drifting at the same speed forever, as in space, because nothing here slows it down. Flying off one edge brings it back on the opposite edge (the Screen Wrap program explains the two % lines). However you hold the keys, even two at once, the number never goes above 250.

Two steps of the same kind: the acceleration times dt is added to the velocity, and the velocity times dt is added to the position. Acceleration is how fast the velocity changes, just as velocity is how fast the position changes. Moving the position by velocity times dt is on the Pygame Basics page; what this program adds is the step before it. With a thrust of 400 pixels per second per second, a ship starting at rest reaches the limit of 250 after about 0.63 seconds.

clamp_magnitude(max_speed) returns a vector with the same direction and a length of at most max_speed. Limiting x and y separately to between -250 and 250 would let a diagonal reach (250, 250), whose length is about 354 - the same flaw as in the Diagonal Speed, Unnormalised program. clamp_magnitude also refuses a zero vector with ValueError, which is why it only runs when the length is greater than 0.
ax and ay subtract the booleans directly (True - False is 1). A diagonal push is about 1.41 times longer, so the ship picks up speed faster diagonally - but the limit is the same in every direction.

The page's checker compares accelerate with a version that measures the speed with math.hypot and scales both components by the limit divided by the speed, on hundreds of made-up velocities, accelerations (some of both zero), frame times and limits.
zh: 窗口里看到的：正中一个橙色圆——飞船，左上角写着 speed 0。按住方向键，飞船慢慢加速；松手后它以同样的速率一直飘下去，像在太空里，因为这里没有任何东西让它减速。从一边飞出去会从对边回来（那两行 % 见「出边绕回」）。不管怎么按键，哪怕同时按两个，那个数都不会超过 250。
两步同一个样子：加速度乘 dt 加到速度上，速度乘 dt 加到位置上。加速度是速度变化的快慢，正如速度是位置变化的快慢。位移 = 速度 × dt 见「pygame 入门」一页；这个程序多加的是它前面那一步。推力是每秒每秒 400 像素时，从静止开始约 0.63 秒就到了 250 的上限。
clamp_magnitude(max_speed) 交回一个方向不变、长度至多 max_speed 的向量。若把 x、y 各自限制在 -250 到 250 之间，斜向可以到 (250, 250)，长度约 354——与「斜向速度：不归一化」同一个毛病。clamp_magnitude 对零向量还会抛 ValueError，所以只在长度大于 0 时才调用它。
ax 与 ay 直接拿布尔相减（True - False 是 1）。斜向的推力约长 1.41 倍，所以斜着加速更快——但各个方向的上限都一样。
页面的检查器把 accelerate 与另一个版本比较：它用 math.hypot 量速率，把两个分量都乘以「上限除以速率」——在几百组随手造的速度、加速度（有的两者都为零）、帧时长与上限上逐一核对。

lineNotes.en: Font(None, 28) is pygame's built-in font at size 28; render draws the text into a new Surface (True means smoothed edges), and the next line copies it onto the screen with blit.
lineNotes.zh: Font(None, 28) 是 pygame 自带的默认字体、字号 28；render 把文字画进一个新的 Surface（True 表示边缘平滑），下一行用 blit 把它贴到屏幕上。

lineNotes.en: clock.tick(60) waits just long enough that the loop runs at most 60 times a second, and returns the milliseconds since its last call; dividing by 1000 turns them into seconds.
lineNotes.zh: clock.tick(60) 等到刚好让循环每秒最多跑 60 次，并交回距上一次调用过了多少毫秒；除以 1000 换成秒。

blurb.en: Every frame gravity adds to the downward velocity and the velocity moves the block; the ground stops it. Space jumps by setting an upward velocity - but only while standing on the ground, so there is no jumping in mid-air.
blurb.zh: 每一帧重力给向下的速度加一点，速度再移动方块；地面把它挡住。空格键起跳，就是给一个向上的速度——但只有站在地上时才行，空中不能再跳。

en: What the window shows: a purple square standing on a grey line near the bottom of a dark window. Press Space and it jumps about 115 pixels up and falls back, spending about 0.8 seconds in the air. Pressing Space again while it is in the air does nothing; once it has landed it can jump again.

GRAVITY is 1500 pixels per second per second, positive because y grows downwards. Each frame gravity first adds to vy (gravity times the frame's time), and then the new vy moves y. A jump sets vy to JUMP_SPEED (-600, upwards): after 0.4 seconds gravity has used that up, the block is at the top, and it starts to fall. The smooth formula (speed squared over twice the gravity) gives a height of 120 pixels; working frame by frame at 60 frames a second it comes out at 115, because the motion is taken in small straight steps rather than one smooth curve.

y is the bottom of the block. When the new y reaches GROUND_Y or goes below it, step puts the block back on the ground with vy = 0 and on_ground = True. Standing still is the same case: a block at rest 'falls' a tiny bit every frame and is put straight back.

on_ground remembers whether the block is standing on something. Without the check, Space in mid-air would reset vy and the block could climb for ever. The Space KEYDOWN event arrives once per press (the Pygame Basics page covers events), so holding the key down does not keep jumping.

The page's checker compares step with a version that works out the new velocity and position in one expression each and decides from them whether the block has landed, on hundreds of made-up heights, velocities and on-ground / jump combinations.
zh: 窗口里看到的：深色窗口底部一条灰线，上面站着一个紫色方块。按空格，它向上跳约 115 像素再落回来，在空中约 0.8 秒。在空中再按空格没有用；落地以后才能再跳。

GRAVITY 是每秒每秒 1500 像素，取正数是因为 y 向下变大。每一帧先让重力给 vy 加一点（重力乘这一帧的时长），再用新的 vy 移动 y。起跳时把 vy 设成 JUMP_SPEED（-600，朝上）：0.4 秒后重力把它抵消完，方块到了最高点，开始下落。按连续的公式（速度的平方除以两倍重力）高度是 120 像素；按每秒 60 帧逐帧算出来是 115，因为运动是一小段一小段直线走的，不是一条光滑曲线。
y 是方块的底边。新的 y 到达或越过 GROUND_Y 时，step 把方块放回地面、vy = 0、on_ground = True。站着不动也是这一种情况：静止的方块每一帧都会「掉下去」一点，又立刻被放回地面。
on_ground 记着方块是不是站在东西上。没有这个判断，空中按空格就会重设 vy，方块可以一直往上爬。空格的 KEYDOWN 事件每按一次只来一次（事件见「pygame 入门」一页），所以按住不放不会连跳。
页面的检查器把 step 与另一个版本比较：它把新速度、新位置各用一个表达式算出来，再据此判断落没落地——在几百组随手造的高度、速度、是否在地面与是否起跳的组合上逐一核对。

lineNotes.en: jump is True for exactly one frame: the frame in which the Space KEYDOWN event arrives.
lineNotes.zh: jump 只在恰好一帧里为 True：空格的 KEYDOWN 事件到来的那一帧。

lineNotes.en: float(...) so that y always comes back as a float, whichever branch runs.
lineNotes.zh: 用 float(...)，让 y 不论走哪个分支交回的都是浮点数。

blurb.en: Three balls bounce between the side walls. When a ball goes through a wall, the overshoot is folded back inside and the velocity is set to point inwards with abs - not merely flipped, which can send a ball the wrong way.
blurb.zh: 三个球在左右两面墙之间来回弹。球穿过墙时，把越过的那一截折回墙内，再用 abs 让速度朝向墙内——而不是简单取反，那样可能把球送错方向。

en: What the window shows: three pink balls on three rows, moving left and right and bouncing off the left and right edges of the window for ever, never losing speed. The top one moves at 180 pixels per second; the middle one, faster at 420, starts off going left. The bottom one starts just outside the window on the left, already moving right, and simply comes in.

LEFT and RIGHT are as far as the centre of a ball can go - one radius in from each edge. After moving by vx * dt a ball can end up some distance past a wall; bounce reflects that position in the wall, so 2 * LEFT - x is as far inside as x was outside. The ball neither sticks to the wall nor loses the part of its step that came after the bounce.

After a bounce the velocity's direction depends on which wall was hit, not on what it was before: abs(vx) at the left wall, -abs(vx) at the right. Simply flipping (vx = -vx) goes wrong when a ball is past a wall but already heading back in - the bottom ball is exactly that case, and flipping would turn it straight back out. A ball caught just outside a wall can then flip every frame and jitter there. With abs, a ball beyond the left wall always ends up moving right.
This is a wall test on one coordinate. Collisions between objects - rectangles, circles, groups - are on the Sprites & Collisions page. The same bounce works for y, with a top and a bottom wall.

The page's checker compares bounce with a version that folds the position with a triangle wave built from % and sets the velocity's sign with math.copysign, on hundreds of made-up positions and velocities, many of them beyond a wall.
zh: 窗口里看到的：三行各一个粉色球，左右移动，碰到窗口左右边缘就弹回来，永远不减速。上面那个每秒 180 像素；中间那个更快，420，一开始向左。下面那个一开始在窗口左边外面一点，已经在向右走，于是直接进来。
LEFT 与 RIGHT 是球心能到的最远处——离两边各一个半径。按 vx * dt 走一步之后，球可能越过墙一段；bounce 把这个位置对墙做镜像，所以 2 * LEFT - x 在墙内的距离正好等于 x 在墙外的距离。球既不会贴在墙上，也不会丢掉反弹之后那半步。
反弹之后速度朝哪边，取决于撞的是哪面墙，而不取决于原来朝哪边：左墙取 abs(vx)，右墙取 -abs(vx)。简单取反（vx = -vx）在一种情况下会错：球已经在墙外、却已经在往回走——下面那个球正是这种情况，取反会把它立刻又送出去。卡在墙外一点点的球还会每帧来回翻转、在那里抖。用 abs，墙左边外面的球最后一定向右走。
这是对一个坐标的撞墙判断。物体之间的碰撞——矩形、圆、精灵组——在「精灵与碰撞」一页。同样的反弹也可以用在 y 上，配上顶墙与底墙。
页面的检查器把 bounce 与另一个版本比较：它用 % 构造的三角波折回位置，用 math.copysign 定速度的符号——在几百组随手造的位置与速度上逐一核对，其中很多在墙外。

lineNotes.en: Each ball is a list [x, vx] so the loop can change it in place; the third one starts 40 pixels beyond the left edge, moving right.
lineNotes.zh: 每个球是一个列表 [x, vx]，循环里可以原地修改；第三个一开始在左边缘外 40 像素处，正向右走。

lineNotes.en: Only x moves; each ball keeps to its own row, 120 pixels apart.
lineNotes.zh: 只有 x 在变；每个球待在自己那一行，行距 120 像素。

blurb.en: Kick two pucks and let friction stop them by keeping 90% of the speed at each update. One puck is updated 60 times a second, the other 30 times: the second slides twice as far, because 'per frame' means different things at different frame rates.
blurb.zh: 踢出两个冰球，让摩擦每次更新保留 90% 的速度把它们停下。一个每秒更新 60 次，另一个 30 次：第二个滑得远一倍，因为「每帧」在不同帧率下是不同的东西。

en: What the window shows: two pucks at the left, a blue one labelled '60 fps: 0 px' and an orange one below labelled '30 fps: 0 px'. Press Space and both are kicked to the right at 600 pixels per second and slide to a stop, the labels counting how far. The blue puck stops after about 100 pixels and about 1 second; the orange one after about 200 pixels and about 2 seconds. Space again puts them back and kicks them again.

Both frame rates run in one window: the loop runs at 60 frames a second, and the second puck is only updated when frame % 2 == 0, with a step twice as long. That is exactly what the same code does on a machine managing only 30 frames a second.

The reason: slow_down multiplies by 0.9 once per update, whatever dt is. It takes dt only so that both friction programs are called the same way - this one ignores it, and that is the flaw. After one second the 60 fps puck has been multiplied by 0.9 sixty times and is down to about 1.08 pixels per second; the 30 fps puck only thirty times, and is still doing about 25. The same game plays differently on a fast machine and a slow one. The fix is the Friction per Second program.
Multiplying by 0.9 never reaches exactly zero, so once the speed is below STOP_SPEED (1 pixel per second) slow_down returns 0.0. It is 0.0 rather than 0 so that the speed is always a float.

The page's checker compares slow_down with a version that multiplies with exact fractions (fractions.Fraction) and only turns the result into a float at the end, on hundreds of made-up speeds (some tiny, to reach the stop), keep fractions and frame times.
zh: 窗口里看到的：左边两个冰球，上面蓝的标着「60 fps: 0 px」，下面橙的标着「30 fps: 0 px」。按空格，两个都以每秒 600 像素被踢向右边，滑行后停下，标签记着滑了多远。蓝的约 1 秒后停在约 100 像素处；橙的约 2 秒后停在约 200 像素处。再按空格就放回原处重新踢。
两种帧率在同一个窗口里跑：循环每秒 60 帧，第二个冰球只在 frame % 2 == 0 时更新，一步的时长加倍。同一段代码在每秒只跑得出 30 帧的机器上，做的正是这件事。
原因：slow_down 每次更新乘一次 0.9，不管 dt 是多少。它收 dt 只是为了让两个摩擦程序的调用方式一样——这一个把它丢掉不用，毛病就在这里。一秒之后，60 帧的冰球已经乘了六十次 0.9，只剩每秒约 1.08 像素；30 帧的只乘了三十次，还有约 25。同一个游戏，在快机器与慢机器上玩起来不一样。改法见「按秒摩擦」。
乘 0.9 永远乘不到恰好为零，所以速度一旦小于 STOP_SPEED（每秒 1 像素），slow_down 就交回 0.0。写 0.0 而不是 0，是为了让速度始终是浮点数。
页面的检查器把 slow_down 与另一个版本比较：它用精确分数（fractions.Fraction）相乘，最后一步才变成浮点数——在几百组随手造的速度（有的很小，好走到「停下」那一支）、保留比例与帧时长上逐一核对。

lineNotes.en: puck[2] is 1 for the first puck and 2 for the second: the second one is updated only on every other frame, with a step twice as long - what a machine running at 30 frames a second would do.
lineNotes.zh: puck[2] 对第一个冰球是 1、第二个是 2：第二个只在隔一帧时才更新，一步的时长加倍——正是每秒 30 帧的机器会做的事。

lineNotes.en: Rounding to 9 decimal places hides the last-digit noise of floating-point arithmetic, so the checker can compare exactly.
lineNotes.zh: 保留 9 位小数，抹掉浮点运算最后几位的噪声，检查器才能精确比较。

blurb.en: The same two pucks, but friction now says how much speed is kept per second and raises it to the power dt. Both pucks slow down at the same rate and stop after nearly the same distance, whatever the frame rate.
blurb.zh: 还是那两个冰球，但摩擦改成「每秒保留多少速度」，再取它的 dt 次方。不管帧率多少，两个冰球减速一样快，停下时滑过的距离也几乎相同。

en: What the window shows: the same two pucks as in the Friction per Frame program, labelled '60 fps' and '30 fps'. Press Space and both are kicked at 600 pixels per second; now both stop after about 1 second, the blue one at about 100 pixels and the orange one at about 105.

The rule: if k of the speed is kept over one second, then k ** dt is kept over dt seconds. Two half-seconds give k ** 0.5 * k ** 0.5, which is k - the same as one whole second - so how the second is cut into frames no longer matters. KEEP_PER_SECOND is 0.9 ** 60, about 0.0018, chosen so that at 60 frames a second each update keeps exactly 0.9, as in the Friction per Frame program: the blue puck behaves exactly as it did there. After one second both pucks are down to about 1.08 pixels per second.

The 5 pixels that remain between the two are not friction: the position moves in steps, and the orange puck travels a full 1/30 of a second at each speed before friction gets another turn. Smaller steps bring the two closer.
As in the Friction per Frame program, a speed that shrinks by a fraction never becomes exactly zero, so below STOP_SPEED slow_down returns the float 0.0.
The page's checker compares slow_down with a version that computes k ** dt as math.exp(dt * math.log(k)), on hundreds of made-up speeds (some tiny, to reach the stop), keep fractions and frame times.
zh: 窗口里看到的：与「每帧摩擦」同样的两个冰球，标着「60 fps」与「30 fps」。按空格，两个都以每秒 600 像素被踢出去；这次两个都约 1 秒后停下，蓝的约在 100 像素处，橙的约在 105 像素处。
规则：一秒保留 k，那么 dt 秒保留 k ** dt。两个半秒是 k ** 0.5 * k ** 0.5，等于 k——与一整秒一次相同——所以一秒怎么切成帧已经无关紧要。KEEP_PER_SECOND 是 0.9 ** 60，约 0.0018，这样选是为了让每秒 60 帧时每次更新正好保留 0.9，与「每帧摩擦」一样：蓝冰球的表现与那边完全相同。一秒之后，两个冰球都只剩每秒约 1.08 像素。
两者之间剩下的 5 像素不是摩擦造成的：位置是一步一步走的，橙冰球每个速度都要走满 1/30 秒，摩擦才轮到下一次。步子越小，两者越接近。
与「每帧摩擦」一样，按比例缩小的速度永远不会恰好为零，所以小于 STOP_SPEED 时 slow_down 交回浮点数 0.0。
页面的检查器把 slow_down 与另一个版本比较：它把 k ** dt 算成 math.exp(dt * math.log(k))——在几百组随手造的速度（有的很小，好走到「停下」那一支）、保留比例与帧时长上逐一核对。

lineNotes.en: Keeping 0.9 per frame at 60 frames a second is keeping 0.9 to the power 60 per second - about 0.0018.
lineNotes.zh: 每秒 60 帧、每帧保留 0.9，就是每秒保留 0.9 的 60 次方——约 0.0018。

lineNotes.en: puck[2] is 1 for the first puck and 2 for the second: the second one is updated only on every other frame, with a step twice as long - what a machine running at 30 frames a second would do.
lineNotes.zh: puck[2] 对第一个冰球是 1、第二个是 2：第二个只在隔一帧时才更新，一步的时长加倍——正是每秒 30 帧的机器会做的事。

blurb.en: Three rocks drift across the window, and whatever leaves by one edge comes back at the opposite edge. One % per coordinate does it: Python's % gives a result between 0 and the width even for negative numbers.
blurb.zh: 三块石头在窗口里漂，从哪条边出去就从对边回来。每个坐标一个 % 就够了：Python 的 % 即使对负数，结果也落在 0 与宽度之间。

en: What the window shows: three light grey circles drifting in different directions - one right and slightly down, one up and to the left, one straight up. When a rock crosses an edge, the part that has gone off appears at the opposite edge, so it slides through smoothly instead of vanishing and popping up.

Taking the remainder by the width keeps x between 0 and WIDTH. In Python the result of % takes the sign of the divisor, so -5 % 640 is 635, 700 % 640 is 60 and -0.5 % 640 is 639.5: one line handles both edges, and there is no if. (Some languages, C and Java among them, give -5 for -5 % 640 - a program ported from them needs an extra step.) For whole numbers the result never reaches the divisor itself; with floats a tiny negative number can round up to exactly the divisor (-1e-20 % 640 is 640.0). That does no harm here: a rock at x = 640 is drawn in exactly the same places as one at 0, and the next frame brings it back below 640.

The smooth crossing is only drawing: each rock is drawn nine times, shifted by a whole width and a whole height in every combination. pygame clips whatever falls outside the window, so the only copies you see are the one inside and, near an edge, the part coming in on the other side.
The rocks never collide with anything; the wrap only decides where they are. The Thrust with a Speed Limit program wraps its ship with the same %, written there as %= on the ship's position.

The page's checker compares wrap with a version that adds or subtracts the width and height in while loops until each coordinate is in range, on hundreds of made-up positions, some several widths off the screen.
zh: 窗口里看到的：三个浅灰色圆各朝一个方向漂——一个向右略偏下，一个向左上，一个径直向上。石头越过边缘时，出去的那一部分出现在对边，所以它是平滑地穿过去，而不是消失后突然冒出来。

对宽度取余数，让 x 保持在 0 与 WIDTH 之间。Python 里 % 的结果与除数同号，所以 -5 % 640 是 635，700 % 640 是 60，-0.5 % 640 是 639.5：一行管住两条边，不用 if。（有些语言，比如 C 与 Java，-5 % 640 得 -5——从那些语言移植过来的程序要多一步。）对整数，结果永远到不了除数本身；对浮点数，极小的负数可能被舍入成恰好等于除数（-1e-20 % 640 是 640.0）。在这里无妨：x = 640 的石头与 x = 0 的石头画在完全相同的位置上，下一帧它又回到 640 以下。
平滑穿越只是画法：每块石头画九次，在宽、高两个方向上各平移一整个宽度与高度的所有组合。窗口外的部分 pygame 会裁掉，所以你看到的只有窗口里那一个，以及靠近边缘时从对边进来的那一部分。
石头不跟任何东西碰撞；绕回只决定它们在哪里。「推力与限速」的飞船用的也是同一个 %，在那里写成对飞船位置的 %=。
页面的检查器把 wrap 与另一个版本比较：它用 while 循环反复加减宽度、高度，直到每个坐标落进范围——在几百组随手造的位置上逐一核对，有的离屏幕好几个宽度远。

lineNotes.en: Drawing partly or wholly outside the window is allowed; pygame simply clips it.
lineNotes.zh: 画到窗口外（部分或全部）是允许的；pygame 会直接裁掉。

lineNotes.en: Each rock is [x, y, vx, vy]: a position and a velocity in pixels per second.
lineNotes.zh: 每块石头是 [x, y, vx, vy]：一个位置、一个以像素每秒计的速度。
